settings.prepare_script:
settings_output=$(xrandr --query | awk '/ connected primary / {print $1; exit}')
test -n "$settings_output" && xrandr --output "$settings_output" --mode 1920x1080
settings_window=$(xdotool search --onlyvisible --name "^put.gd$")
test "$(printf "%s\n" "$settings_window" | wc -l)" -eq 1 && xdotool windowsize "$settings_window" 1440 960 windowmove "$settings_window" 120 40
